info.title: Sim API v2 — Workspace Resources
info.description:
The v2 Workspace Resources API covers the resources a workspace is provisioned with: MCP servers, skills, custom tools, folders, credentials, and secrets.

## Conventions

All endpoints live under the `/api/v2` base path and share a single set of conventions:

- **Authentication** — Send your Sim API key in the `X-API-Key` header on every request. Keys are scoped to a workspace (or are personal keys that target a workspace); `workspaceId` is always required so the request can be tenant-scoped and rate-limited.
- **Single-resource and mutation responses** return `{ "data": ... }`.
- **List responses** use an opaque-cursor envelope: `{ "data": [ ... ], "nextCursor": string | null }`. Pass the returned `nextCursor` back as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page. When `nextCursor` is `null` there are no more results. Cursors are opaque — do not parse or construct them.
- **Errors** use a single envelope: `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details"?: unknown } }`. The HTTP status code and the stable `code` field move together (for example `404` ⇄ `NOT_FOUND`).
- **Rate limiting** — Every response carries the current limiter state in the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. A throttled request returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header.
- **Secrets are write-only** — Secret values and MCP request-header values are accepted on write and never returned. Secret reads expose metadata only.

get.description: Return public metadata for one accessible workspace. Governance identities, billing identities, and internal membership identifiers are intentionally omitted.

List the workspace's effective members ordered by email. Explicit workspace grants and inherited organization-admin grants are merged. User IDs, membership IDs, role provenance, and billing identities are never returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum members to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not parse or construct it.

200.description: An email-ordered page of effective workspace members.

get.description:
List the MCP servers registered in a workspace. The per-workspace set is small and bounded, so the full set is returned as a single page and `nextCursor` is always `null`; treat the response as a standard cursor list so pagination can be added later without a contract change.

Configured request header **values** are never returned — use `hasHeaders` and `headerNames` to see which headers are set.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the MCP server `name`. Matches nothing else — not ids, descriptions, or content. `%` and `_` are matched literally. Must be non-empty; omit the parameter instead of sending a blank one.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

200.description: MCP servers registered in the workspace.

data.description: The MCP servers registered in the workspace.

post.description:
Register a new MCP server in a workspace. Requires `write` permission on the workspace.

A server's identity is derived from its URL, so registering a URL that is already registered returns `409 CONFLICT` rather than overwriting the existing server — use `PATCH /api/v2/mcp-servers/{id}` to change one.

The `url` must be an absolute `http`/`https` URL and may not contain `{{ENV_VAR}}` references: templated hostnames defer domain-allowlist and SSRF checks to call time, which is not safe to accept over an API key.

`headers` and `oauthClientSecret` are write-only and are never returned.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL

oauth.summary: OAuth server with pre-registered client credentials

get.description: Fetch a single MCP server by id. Configured request header values and the OAuth client secret are never returned.

patch.description:
Update an MCP server's configuration. Only the fields you send are changed. Requires `write` permission on the workspace.

`url` is immutable: a server's id is derived from its URL, so re-pointing it would leave the id hashing an address the server no longer uses and allow two servers on one URL. Sending a different `url` returns `400` — delete the server and create one at the new address. Sending the URL it already has is accepted, so a full-object PATCH still works.

Changing the auth type or the OAuth client credentials invalidates any existing OAuth grant for the server and resets its connection state.

requestBody.description: The fields to change. `workspaceId` is required so the request is tenant-scoped.

delete.description: Remove an MCP server from the workspace and revoke any OAuth tokens issued for it. Requires `write` permission on the workspace. Workflows that referenced the server's tools keep their blocks but can no longer call it.

get.description:
List the skills available in a workspace. Built-in template skills that ship with Sim are included and are marked `readOnly: true`.

Skill bodies can be up to 50 000 characters, so the list returns summaries only — fetch `GET /api/v2/skills/{id}` for a skill's `content`. The per-workspace set is small and bounded, so the full set is returned as a single page and `nextCursor` is always `null`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the skill `name`. Matches nothing else — not ids, descriptions, or content. `%` and `_` are matched literally. Must be non-empty; omit the parameter instead of sending a blank one.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Built-in skills have no stored timestamps and sort as if created at the Unix epoch.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

data.description: The skills available in the workspace, without their bodies.

data.name: deploy-workflow
data.description: How to deploy a finished workflow

data.name: refund-policy
data.description: How support should handle refund requests

post.description:
Create a skill in a workspace. Requires `write` permission on the workspace, and the creator becomes an editor of the new skill.

`name` must be kebab-case and unique in the workspace; names reserved by built-in skills are rejected. Unlike the internal endpoint this creates exactly one skill and answers with it, not with the whole workspace list.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST \
  "https://www.sim.ai/api/v2/skills" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "workspaceId": "YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID",
    "name": "refund-policy",
    "description": "How support should handle refund requests",
    "content": "# Refund policy\n\nAlways check the order date first."
  }'

value.name: refund-policy
value.description: How support should handle refund requests
value.content:
# Refund policy

Always check the order date first.

skill.name: refund-policy
skill.description: How support should handle refund requests
skill.content:
# Refund policy

Always check the order date first.

get.description: Fetch a single skill by id, including its full `content`. Built-in template skills resolve here too and are marked `readOnly: true`.

skill.name: refund-policy
skill.description: How support should handle refund requests
skill.content:
# Refund policy

Always check the order date first.

patch.description:
Update a skill. Only the fields you send are changed, so a partial edit never clobbers a concurrent change to a field you did not send.

Requires skill editor access — an explicit editor grant on the skill, or workspace admin. Built-in skills are read-only and are rejected.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X PATCH \
  "https://www.sim.ai/api/v2/skills/V1StGXR8Z5jdHi6BmyT" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "workspaceId": "YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID",
    "description": "Updated refund guidance"
  }'

requestBody.description: The fields to change. At least one of `name`, `description`, or `content` is required.

value.content:
# Refund policy

Check the order date, then the payment method.

skill.name: refund-policy
skill.content:
# Refund policy

Always check the order date first.

delete.description: Delete a skill from the workspace. Requires skill editor access — an explicit editor grant on the skill, or workspace admin. Built-in skills are read-only and are rejected.

get.description:
List the custom tools defined in a workspace. Custom tools are code-backed functions agents can call, declared with an OpenAI-style function schema.

Only workspace tools are returned — legacy personal tools, which predate workspace scoping and belong to a single user, are not part of the public API. The per-workspace set is small and bounded, so the full set is returned as a single page and `nextCursor` is always `null`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the custom tool `title`. Matches nothing else — not ids, descriptions, or content. `%` and `_` are matched literally. Must be non-empty; omit the parameter instead of sending a blank one.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

200.description: Custom tools defined in the workspace.

data.description: The custom tools defined in the workspace.

data.title: lookup_order

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up an order by id

data.code:
const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/orders/${orderId}`)
return await res.json()

post.description:
Create a custom tool in a workspace. Requires `write` permission on the workspace.

`title` must be unique within the workspace — tools resolve by title at call time, so a duplicate returns `409 CONFLICT`. `code` is the tool body, executed in Sim's sandboxed function runtime with the schema's parameters bound as variables.

lookupOrder.summary: A tool that calls an internal API

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up an order by id

value.code:

return await res.json()

get.description: Fetch a single custom tool by id, scoped to the workspace.

patch.description:
Update a custom tool. Only the fields you send are changed; omitted fields keep their stored values. Requires `write` permission on the workspace.

Renaming onto a title another tool already uses returns `409 CONFLICT`.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X PATCH \
  "https://www.sim.ai/api/v2/custom-tools/V1StGXR8Z5jdHi6BmyT" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "workspaceId": "YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID",
    "code": "return { ok: false }"
  }'

requestBody.description: The fields to change. At least one of `title`, `schema`, or `code` is required.

delete.description: Delete a custom tool from the workspace. Requires `write` permission on the workspace. Agent blocks that referenced the tool keep their configuration but can no longer call it.

get.description:
List the OAuth and service-account connections visible to the caller in a workspace. Environment secrets are a separate resource under `/api/v2/secrets`. Credential creation, update, deletion, and single-resource reads are intentionally not exposed yet.

Secret material is never returned. `hasServiceAccountKey` reports only whether a service-account payload is configured. The workspace credential set is small and bounded, so `nextCursor` is always `null`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only return connections of this kind.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: Only return credentials for this integration.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against `displayName`.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

200.description: OAuth and service-account credentials visible to the caller.

get.description: List workspace and caller-owned personal secret metadata. Only names, scope, role, and timestamps are returned. Secret values are never read or returned by this API.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `workspace` for a shared workspace secret or `personal` for the caller-owned catalog.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the secret name.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

200.description: Secret metadata visible to the caller.

put.description: Create or replace a workspace or caller-owned personal secret. The value is encrypted at rest and is never included in the response. Updating an existing workspace secret requires credential-admin access to that secret; creating one requires workspace write access.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Secret name. Letters, numbers, and underscores only.

requestBody.description: The secret value and its scope. `value` is write-only.

200.description: The existing secret value was replaced.

delete.description: Delete a workspace or caller-owned personal secret. The stored value is never read or returned. Deleting an existing workspace secret requires credential-admin access to that secret.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Secret name. Letters, numbers, and underscores only.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `workspace` for a shared workspace secret or `personal` for the caller-owned catalog.

RateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or failed validation. Inspect `error.details` for field-level issues.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or invalid. Ensure the X-API-Key header is set with a valid key.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated caller does not have the required permission on the workspace, or the URL was rejected by the server's MCP domain policy.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not accessible from this workspace.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the workspace — for example a resource with the same identity already exists.

error.message: An MCP server with this URL already exists in this workspace.

Locked.description: A mutation lock on the resource (or something inside it) blocks the change. Unlock it and retry.

error.message: This folder is locked and cannot be modified

RateLimited.description: The rate limit has been exceeded. Retry after the period indicated by the Retry-After header.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

ServiceUnavailable.description: An upstream provider could not be reached to verify the request. Retry shortly.

error.message: The credential provider is unavailable. Try again.

details.description: Optional structured context for the error, such as field-level validation issues.

NextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. Pass it back as the `cursor` query parameter. Do not parse or construct cursors.

DeleteAcknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement that a resource was deleted.

id.description: The identifier of the resource that was deleted.

Workspace.description: Public workspace metadata. Governance and billing identities are intentionally omitted.

memberCount.description: Number of effective members, including inherited organization admins.

WorkspaceMember.description: An effective workspace member identified publicly by email.

McpServer.description: An MCP server registered in a workspace. Request header values and the OAuth client secret are write-only and never appear here.

id.description: The server's unique identifier, derived from the workspace and the server URL.

transport.description: Transport used to talk to the server.

authType.description: How Sim authenticates to the server.

enabled.description: Whether the server's tools are available to workflows.

connectionStatus.description: Result of the most recent connection attempt.

lastError.description: Message from the most recent failed connection, if any.

toolCount.description: Number of tools discovered on the server.

lastToolsRefresh.description: When the server's tool list was last refreshed.

oauthClientId.description: Pre-registered OAuth client id, when the server does not support dynamic client registration.

hasHeaders.description: Whether any request headers are configured. Values are never returned.

headerNames.description: Names of the configured request headers. Values are never returned.

hasOauthClientSecret.description: Whether an OAuth client secret is stored for this server.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to register the server in.

transport.description: Transport used to talk to the server. Defaults to `streamable-http`.

url.description: Absolute http or https endpoint URL. May not contain `{{ENV_VAR}}` references.

authType.description: How Sim should authenticate. Detected from the server when omitted.

headers.description: Write-only. Request headers sent to the server, e.g. `Authorization`. Never returned on read.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

retries.description: Number of retries per request. Defaults to 3.

enabled.description: Whether the server's tools are available to workflows. Defaults to true.

oauthClientId.description: Pre-registered OAuth client id for servers without dynamic client registration.

oauthClientSecret.description: Write-only. Pre-registered OAuth client secret. Never returned on read.

UpdateMcpServerBody.description: Fields to change on an existing MCP server. Omitted fields are left as they are.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the server.

url.description: Immutable. Must equal the server's current URL — a different value returns `400`, because the server's id is derived from its URL.

headers.description: Write-only. Replaces the stored header map wholesale.

name.description: Kebab-case name, unique within the workspace. This is what agents reference.

description.description: One-line summary of when the skill applies.

readOnly.description: True for built-in template skills, which ship with Sim and cannot be modified or deleted.

name.description: Kebab-case name, unique within the workspace. This is what agents reference.

description.description: One-line summary of when the skill applies.

content.description: The skill body — the instructions handed to the agent.

readOnly.description: True for built-in template skills, which ship with Sim and cannot be modified or deleted.

name.description: Kebab-case name, unique within the workspace. Names reserved by built-in skills are rejected.

description.description: One-line summary of when the skill applies.

content.description: The skill body — the instructions handed to the agent.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the skill.

title.description: Display title, unique within the workspace.
